data.one_liner: A control panel UI widget laid on top of VideoPlayer with play, pause, seek, and fullscreen support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable control panel UI overlay for video_player instances. Supports closed captions, subtitles, volume adjustment, playlists, full-screen mode, and D-pad navigation for TVs.
use_when: You need a ready-made video player control interface over VideoPlayer.
You want to support playlists and full-screen playback on Android, iOS, Web, and Windows.
You need D-pad navigation for Android TV or Apple TV applications.
avoid_when: You need a completely custom video controls design from scratch.
You are using a video player engine other than video_player.
strengths: Includes support for playlists and PanelController for programmatic control.
Supports closed captions and subtitles (SubRip and WebVTT).
Provides D-pad navigation support for TV platforms.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the underlying video_player and video_player_win packages.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding video_player_control_panel to pubspec.yaml and wrapping your VideoPlayerController.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick video_player if you want to build your own custom video controls completely from scratch without using a pre-made overlay package.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick just_audio if your primary requirement is advanced audio playback features or complex playlist handling rather than video UI controls.
